Question: My question is: is it right for a Muslim man to go to gym & do the act of body building? Answer ID: 5582 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 312/312=M) It is ok, and with good intention it is an act of reward as well, as the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) said: إ نما ال أ عمال بالنیات ?The actions are governed by intentions.? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
